Class BankAccountSelectorTest

@IsTest()
private class BankAccountSelectorTest

Tests for BankAccountSelector. Exercises every public selector method (getBankAccountByCode, getBankAccountById, getBankAccountByExternalId, getBankAccountsByType, getBankAccountsByVenue) for both matching and non-matching scenarios, including the active-status filter on the bulk queries.

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
getBankAccountByCodeExceptionTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountByCode traps the SOQL exception raised by an over-long input and surfaces it through Result.hasException() rather than letting it propagate.
private static void
getBankAccountByCodeNoMatchTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountByCode returns an empty list when no record matches the supplied code.
private static void
getBankAccountByCodeReturnsMatchingRecordTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountByCode returns the bank account whose Code__c matches and projects the expected venue/address fields.
private static void
getBankAccountByExternalIdExceptionTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountByExternalId traps the SOQL exception raised by an over-long input and surfaces it through Result.hasException() rather than letting it propagate.
private static void
getBankAccountByExternalIdNoMatchTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountsByExternalId returns an empty list when no record matches the supplied external Id.
private static void
getBankAccountByExternalIdReturnsMatchingRecordTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountByExternalId returns the bank account whose ExternalId__c matches and projects the expected fields.
private static void
getBankAccountByIdExceptionTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountById traps the SOQL exception raised by an over-long input and surfaces it through Result.hasException() rather than letting it propagate.
private static void
getBankAccountByIdReturnsMatchingRecordTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountById returns the bank account whose Id matches and projects the expected detail fields.
private static void
getBankAccountsByTypeExceptionTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountsByType traps the SOQL exception raised by an over-long input and surfaces it through Result.hasException() rather than letting it propagate.
private static void
getBankAccountsByTypeReturnsActiveOnlyTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountsByType returns only active bank accounts of the requested record type, excluding records whose Status__c is not active.
private static void
getBankAccountsByVenueExceptionTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountsByVenue traps the SOQL exception raised by an over-long input and surfaces it through Result.hasException() rather than letting it propagate.
private static void
getBankAccountsByVenueFiltersByActiveAndVenueTest()
Verifies that getBankAccountsByVenue returns only active bank accounts belonging to the supplied venue, excluding inactive records and records belonging to a different venue.
